newsitem.title: POLAND: New Polish finmin Belka against zloty devaluation.
newsitem.headline: New Polish finmin Belka against zloty devaluation.

text.p: Poland's new Finance Minister Marek Belka on Thursday said that a zloty devaluation was not needed to trim the country's widening trade deficit.

"Although we are concerned with the deepening registered trade deficit we are not going to devaluate the zloty to prop up exports," Belka said in a telephone interview for Reuters Financial Television.

The zloty's exchange rate mechanism is controlled by the independent central bank. Poland's trade deficit ballooned to $7.2 billion zlotys in the January-November period of last year from $1.3 billion in the same period of 1995.
